propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (HTTP 429) responses are treated as hard failures instead of retriable events with Retry-After headers
429 retries must not be applied to mutations (create_issue, add_comment, add_label) because a 429 can arrive after the server began the write, risking duplicate resource creation
Per-call opt-in mechanism for 429 retry on idempotent reads must default to OFF to prevent mutations from inheriting retry behavior by omission
429 retry exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429) through _as_backend_http_error, never expose raw JIRAError vendor exceptions
Retry-After delays must be calculated as: min(MAX_BACKOFF_S, retry_after * (1 + random.uniform(0, 0.2))) — jitter first, clamp last — per Atlassian guidance
transport.py at 789 lines against locked 800-line cap leaves insufficient headroom to add 429 policy in place, forcing extraction of retry/error cluster to separate module
